paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在正文中引用[23]作为FMCW雷达信号处理的基础参考，用于说明Range-FFT、Doppler-FFT和Angle-FFT等基本原理，属于技术背景引用，并非对目标论文能力或贡献的直接阐述。

evidences.evidence_quote: We suggest readers refer to relevant sources [23] for understanding their functions.
evidences.evidence_context: In order to utilize the velocity information earlier in object detection and thus focus on the weakly vibrating objects, this article adopts the so-called 4D-FFT point cloud generation process. This process involves radar signal processing processes called Range-FFT, Doppler-FFT, and Angle-FFT. We suggest readers refer to relevant sources [23] for understanding their functions.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: [23]是德州仪器的一份技术文档，并非引用论文的目标论文（Wang等人的RFID亚毫米级振动感知论文）。正文引用[23]仅作为FMCW雷达基本原理的参考来源，与目标论文无关，属于误引用。
